organizer: Mechanisms Education Association (MEA), hosted by a rotating NASA center together with Lockheed Martin Space (e.g. NASA MSFC 2026, NASA LaRC 2024, NASA KSC 2028)
fields: spacecraft and aircraft mechanisms (design, fabrication, test, operations)
deployment mechanisms (antennas, solar arrays, solar sails, instruments)
frequency: Biennial (even years), alternating with ESMATS in odd years

submission.type: Summary of about 1000 words plus figures (4 pages max) e-mailed to the general chair; accepted authors write a 14-page paper (or 6-page poster paper) for NASA conference proceedings
submission.typical_abstract_deadline: Mid-to-late November of the year before (about 6 months before the symposium)
submission.notes: 48th AMS (2026): summaries originally due 16 Nov 2025, extended to 30 Nov 2025; authors notified late Nov 2025; final 14-page paper due 15 Mar 2026. Selection favours flown or fully tested hardware and lessons learned. The 49th AMS (NASA Kennedy Space Center, May 2028) had no call for papers yet as of 2026-10-16.

next_edition.notes: 49th AMS, to be held at NASA Kennedy Space Center, Florida in May 2028, hosted with Lockheed Martin Space. Exact dates and the summary deadline were not announced as of 2026-10-16; by pattern summaries would be due around November 2027.

47th AMS, hosted by NASA Langley Research Center and Lockheed Martin Space; proceedings NASA/CP-20240005548. Cross-checked 2026-10-16: abstract_deadline filled 2023-11-15 (summaries due 15 November 2023, official 47th AMS call for papers; no later extension found).

48th AMS, hosted by NASA Marshall Space Flight Center and Lockheed Martin Space. The summary deadline was extended from 16 Nov 2025 to 30 Nov 2025 (https://aeromechanisms.com/). The AMS past-symposia page lists 15-17 May 2026, but the official programme and the call for papers both give 13-15 May 2026.

49th AMS, 'NASA Kennedy Space Center, Florida - May 2028', in co-operation with NASA KSC and Lockheed Martin Space (official aeromechanisms.com homepage). Exact dates and summary deadline not announced. Cross-checked 2026-10-16: edition added from the independent pass and confirmed on the official AMS homepage.

notes: The AMS is often described as 'NASA/Lockheed'. Formally it is organised by the non-profit Mechanisms Education Association, with a NASA center and Lockheed Martin Space as hosts, and the proceedings appear as NASA Conference Publications. Papers are archived at https://www.esmats.eu/amspapers/. The 48th AMS (2026) opened with a dedicated 'Deployables' session (6 papers), and its poster session included several origami/deployable telescope and hinge papers. Summary deadlines for 2014-2024 were not found. The 45th (2020) was cancelled, with proceedings only, and the 46th (2022) was held virtually.
